record.paper_title: Group actions on 4-manifolds: some recent results and open questions
record.context_brief: Linearity of finite smooth actions on S^4 with isolated fixed point
record.original_question: Is every smooth action of a finite group on S^4 that has an isolated fixed point smoothly conjugate to a linear action?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 2.2. A smooth finite group action on S4 with an isolated fixed point is smoothly conjugate to a linear action.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite group acting smoothly on the 4-sphere $S^4$, and suppose this action has at least one isolated fixed point (i.e., a point $p\in S^4$ fixed by every element of $G$ such that $\{p\}$ is a connected component of the fixed-point set $(S^4)^G$). A linear action of $G$ on $S^4$ is one obtained from an orthogonal representation $G\to O(5)$ via the standard inclusion $S^4\subset\mathbb{R}^5$. Two smooth $G$-actions on $S^4$ are smoothly conjugate if there exists a $G$-equivariant diffeomorphism between them.

Question: Is every smooth action of a finite group $G$ on $S^4$ that possesses an isolated fixed point smoothly conjugate to a linear action of $G$ on $S^4$?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture that smooth finite group actions on $S^4$ with an isolated fixed point are smoothly conjugate to linear actions remains open in general. Recent works (e.g., 2025 paper on involutions on $S^4$) treat partial cases such as locally linear involutions with prescribed fixed-set dimensions, and related rank conjectures, but no general resolution is reported.

status_evidence.title: Involutions on S^4
status_evidence.snippet: Studies locally linear involutions on S^4 with 1- and 2-dimensional fixed sets and conditions for conjugacy to linear actions.
status_evidence.claim: Linearity questions for finite actions on S^4 are still being actively investigated in special cases.

status_evidence.title: Rank conditions for finite group actions on 4-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses rank constraints and linearity-type conjectures for finite group actions on 4-manifolds, including S^4.
status_evidence.claim: General linearization of finite smooth actions on S^4 remains conjectural.

status_evidence.title: Finite symmetries of R^4 and S^4 (Kwasik-Schultz)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-style notes on finite group symmetries of R^4 and S^4, indicating open status of linearization conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Linearization for smooth finite actions on S^4 with isolated fixed point is still listed among open problems.
